question: Does new evidence from BM25 help the fixed 7B on the items route 1 repairs? L2 bge20_bm2520_ce_only failed on confirm as a whole; split by mechanism, its gain came from Top-5 lists that hold a BM25-only passage, and its loss from re-ordering the same BGE passages.
fixed: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct NF4 (rev a09a354) is not trained. Route 1 is unchanged up to its final answer.

rule.setting: L2 bge20_bm2520_ce_only of configs/controller/l2_round_v1.json step_2_l2: BGE top 20 plus BM25 top 20, GPU cross-encoder, top 5 by cross-encoder score
rule.replace: when that Top-5 holds at least one passage outside the BGE top 20 (brought in by BM25), the final answer is the L2 answer under P3-20 rules: build_c1_prompt, the shared Qwen generator, and answer_rejection keeping the C1 answer; otherwise the route-1 answer stays
rule.cost: one candidate stage (BGE, BM25, GPU cross-encoder) per P3 item and one extra 7B generation on the replaced items

evidence.status: post hoc: the split was made after the L2 confirm result (artifacts/controller/l2_confirm_v1) was seen, so confirm is not independent evidence
evidence.sweep: 812 of 3,013 routed items hold a BM25-only passage; against route 1 fix 93, harm 54, net +39, exact McNemar p = 0.0016
evidence.confirm: 334 of 1,206 routed items; against route 1 fix 43, harm 27, net +16, p = 0.072
evidence.other_part: items without a BM25-only passage (L2 only re-orders the BGE top 20): sweep net +1 (158/157), confirm net -17 (55/72)

test.set: team Test 11,114, a further disclosed exposure after the route-1 Test; route 2's partial Test outputs stay unscored
test.id_source: route-1 Test items with controller action retrieval_enhancement, in Test order (artifacts/controller/quality_test_v1 scored/predictions.jsonl)
test.runs: scripts/l2_candidates.py candidates --role test on these IDs (BGE 100 and BM25 50 precomputed as on the sweep and confirm; only the top 20 of each are used), then scripts/l2_generate.py on the contexts the rule needs; Test queries only, gold stays local
test.labels: team qwen_only, team product, route-1 Test judge, the new judge batch, team RAG last (RAG wins on conflicts), as in the route-1 Test
test.adoption: paired against route 1 on Test: judge-assisted net > 0 and exact McNemar p < 0.05
test.report: also net against C1, team RAG and the team product

metric: judge-assisted correctness. Unchanged answers count zero.
